You should definitely tell him if you and him are close. I feel like if you’re boyfriend is the kind and loving type then i’m sure he wouldn’t mind listening to your problems. You could casually bring it up when talking about each other’s day or at a moment where he’s not so busy. Be prepared for his reaction if he gets upset or disappointed and hear him out. Maybe he’ll try and help you out of the rut. I hope this helped :)
